## Type of change

- [ ] feat — new functionality
- [ ] fix — bug fix

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title is a valid [Conventional Commit](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] `make check` passes locally (lint, vuln, tests)
- [ ] New/changed code is covered by tests
- [ ] **If it changes what diskdiet deletes:** a test shows what is removed and what stays, and every removal goes through `fsx.Remove`
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, command help, README) for user-facing changes
